description: The file defines a Java class UpgradeServices that provides utility services related to data upgrade tasks in the OFBiz framework, such as generating SQL scripts for altering table timestamp columns to support microseconds in MySQL.

classes.name: UpgradeServices
classes.description: A utility class providing services for data upgrade operations, including generating SQL scripts to alter table columns for compatibility with MySQL 5.6+ timestamps.

methods.name: generateMySqlFileWithAlterTableForTimestamps
methods.description: Generates an SQL script to modify datetime and time fields in database tables for MySQL versions supporting fractional seconds, based on entity models within a specified group.
